findings.claim: docs/03-guides/quick-start.md presents uv sync --extra tracing and make install as the same canonical bootstrap, but Makefile install uses a different extra set.
findings.observation: After showing uv sync --extra dev --extra tests --extra tracing, quick-start.md says canonical bootstrap uses uv sync / make install / python -m scripts.ops setup-plugins. Makefile install is uv sync --extra dev --extra tests --extra tests_full --extra export (no tracing). README Quick Start already warns these extra-sets are not the same.
findings.broken_invariant: RULES.md section 6 contributor sync: contributor-facing bootstrap commands MUST stay consistent across active docs.
findings.method: inspection of docs/03-guides/quick-start.md:39-51 vs Makefile:99-100 vs README.md:167-173
findings.expected: Each named bootstrap path lists the extras of the matching Makefile/README target, or points to a single SSOT without equating them.
findings.actual: quick-start.md equates the tracing extra-set with make install extras.
findings.impact: A reader who ran the shown uv sync may believe they have the make install extra-set (tests_full+export), then fail architecture/benchmark suites. A reader who follows make install after that sentence gets export instead of tracing.
findings.root_cause: quick-start.md collapsed two documented extra-sets into one sentence after README split them.

evidence.observation: Canonical bootstrap uses uv sync / make install / python -m scripts.ops setup-plugins
uv sync --extra dev --extra tests --extra tests_full --extra export
minimal local-dev extra-set is not the same as make install

findings.acceptance: quick-start.md uses make install as the only named aggregate or lists extras that match Makefile install / README without equating them.
validation: rg -n "make install|uv sync --extra" docs/03-guides/quick-start.md README.md Makefile
validation_commands: rg -n "make install|uv sync --extra" docs/03-guides/quick-start.md README.md Makefile
findings.rollback: Revert the canonical-bootstrap sentence in quick-start.md.
findings.remediation: Split the tracing extra-set and make install in quick-start.md the same way README.md already does.
findings.automation: Optional test that Makefile install extras and quick-start named extras stay aligned.

findings.claim: docs/03-guides/github-workflow-diagrams.md still documents a release CI matrix of Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13.
findings.observation: Mermaid release flow says Test on Py 3.11, 3.12, 3.13. release.yml python-version is only 3.13. tests.yml defaults to 3.12 with a 3.13 group; 3.11 is not in either workflow.
findings.broken_invariant: RULES.md section 6: active docs about required checks MUST match CI.
findings.expected: Diagram Python versions match workflows (3.12 baseline, 3.13 in release/selected jobs; no 3.11).
findings.actual: Diagram still lists Python 3.11 as a tested release matrix member.
findings.impact: Release operators may wait for or debug a 3.11 job that does not exist; contradicts README policy that 3.10/3.11 mentions are deprecated.
findings.root_cause: Release visualization was not re-verified against current workflow python-version pins.
findings.acceptance: Diagram Python versions match release.yml and tests.yml; 3.11 removed.
findings.remediation: Replace the mermaid CI test line with 3.12 baseline / 3.13 release as in current workflows.
findings.automation: check-links --workflow-inventory does not cover mermaid Python versions; extend or add a targeted test.

findings.claim: README documents a lint command surface that does not match Makefile lint.
findings.observation: README: uv run ruff check . and mypy --strict --no-incremental src/bioetl. Makefile lint: ruff check src tests scripts and mypy src/bioetl. CONTRIBUTING.md tells contributors to run make lint.
findings.broken_invariant: RULES.md section 6 contributor sync for required checks.
findings.expected: README lint block names the same commands as make lint, or says make lint is SSOT.
findings.actual: README uses repo-wide ruff check . and extra mypy flags; Makefile uses a narrower ruff path and mypy without those flags.
findings.impact: Contributors following README vs make lint get different lint scope.
findings.root_cause: README kept a direct toolchain recipe after Makefile became the contributor SSOT.
findings.acceptance: README lint section defers to make lint or copies Makefile recipes exactly.
findings.remediation: Point README Development linting at make lint, or duplicate Makefile commands exactly.

findings.claim: The published pipeline failure recovery runbook still carries Last verified 2026-04-03.
findings.observation: Header Last verified is 2026-04-03. Adjacent ops index Last verified 2026-08-26. REQ-ROLLBACK-001 binds this runbook as rollback procedure SSOT. This audit did not re-execute the runbook end-to-end against current CLI, so procedure text is not claimed wrong—only the verification stamp.
findings.broken_invariant: Operational runbooks in docs/05-operations MUST stay re-verified after runtime change (NORMATIVE_SOURCES DOC-GOV-09).
findings.expected: Last verified no older than the last control-plane/CLI change the runbook describes, or an explicit re-verify in 2026-08/09.
findings.impact: Operators cannot tell whether recovery/rollback steps were re-checked against current bioetl CLI and control-plane artifacts.
findings.root_cause: Runbook metadata was not restamped when ops index and runtime surfaces moved.
findings.acceptance: Re-verify the procedure against current CLI and stamp Last verified.
findings.remediation: Walk the runbook against current python -m bioetl surfaces and update Last verified.
findings.automation: Optional freshness lint on docs/05-operations/** headers.

findings.claim: README documentation validation block omits check-drift --runtime-mirrors --freshness, which NORMATIVE_SOURCES and docs-verification treat as the runtime-mirror gate.
findings.observation: README.md:643-645 lists check-links --links --specs --configs, check-drift --ports --classes, check-docstrings --summary. docs-verification.md:125-126 and NORMATIVE_SOURCES.md:75 also require --runtime-mirrors --freshness. This audit ran both; both passed. Gap is an incomplete contributor recipe, not a failing gate.
findings.broken_invariant: RULES.md section 6 contributor sync for required docs checks.
findings.method: inspection README.md:643-645 vs docs/03-guides/docs-verification.md:125-126 vs NORMATIVE_SOURCES.md:75; command evidence check-drift --runtime-mirrors --freshness exit 0 at 2026-09-15T10:56:30Z
findings.expected: README docs validation either lists both drift invocations or defers entirely to docs-verification.md.
findings.impact: A contributor following only README can skip runtime-mirror/freshness drift that AGENTS.md post-change policy requires.
findings.root_cause: README kept a shortened docs-check recipe.
findings.acceptance: README points to docs-verification.md as SSOT or includes the mirrors/freshness invocation.
findings.remediation: Replace the three-line README docs recipe with a pointer to docs/03-guides/docs-verification.md, or add the second check-drift invocation.
